LESSON: FREE-HAND SKETCHING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.2: Free-hand sketching

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Free-hand sketching. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how free-hand sketches express artistic ideas in different career fields, Why is free- hand sketching important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the principles of free-hand sketching
2. Identify techniques of free-hand sketching

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: FREE-HAND SKETCHING
This lesson teaches Free-hand sketching for Grade 7 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the principles of free-hand sketching
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Identify techniques of free-hand sketching
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Free-hand sketching using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Free-hand sketching above.
2. Explain Free-hand sketching to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Free-hand sketching.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Free-hand sketching with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Free-hand sketching important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how free-hand sketches express artistic ideas in different career fields, Why is free- hand sketching important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the principles of free-hand sketching
2. Identify techniques of free-hand sketching

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
